channel.title: Latch
channel.description: Updates for Latch, a grid window manager for macOS.

item.title: Latch 1.0.1
item.description:
Grids can now be anything from 1×1 up to 16×16 — in the drag grid, in your saved placements, and in the introduction. The old limit was 8×8, and 2×2 at the low end.

A single row or column is genuinely useful: one column means dragging anywhere across the screen fills the width, which is the fastest possible “maximise”.

Fixed: a placement whose grid was made smaller could keep a selection from the larger grid and place the window off-screen. Placements now stay on-screen however the grid is resized.

Also: builds are now universal, so Latch runs natively on both Apple silicon and Intel Macs.
